title: Isoperimetric and total curvature inequalities in Cartan-Hadamard manifolds with nullity
summary: Using the Chern-Gauss-Bonnet theorem, we establish a sharp inequality for the total Gauss-Kronecker curvature of convex hypersurfaces in Cartan-Hadamard manifolds $M^n$ with nullity index at least $n-3$. Consequently, the Euclidean isoperimetric inequality extends to $M^n$, which proves the Cartan-Hadamard conjecture for these spaces.
